verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app. A product of this kind could plausibly publish an API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API reference, interactive or otherwise, and no runnable examples. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. The only command-line mentions are build and run instructions, such as `swift run SillHost --synthetic`, which are not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
